[Google Cloud (Agentspace, Gemini)]

Fargo virtual assistant in the Wells Fargo Mobile app handles customer banking tasks (balances, transaction search, bill pay, card management) via conversational AI. Built on Google Cloud Dialogflow with a model-agnostic/Gemini Flash orchestration that keeps PII out of the LLM. Handled 245.4M interactions in 2024 and surpassed 1 billion total interactions by March 2026. [Google Cloud (Dialogflow, Gemini Flash)]
